routes.name: Pilgrimage
routes.what_it_is: Nineteen passages joined by phrases they share, from the first day to the new creation. The threads are the whole idea.

routes.name: Canonical
routes.what_it_is: All sixty-six books, first chapter to last. Nothing chosen for you, and nothing left out.

routes.name: Narrative
routes.what_it_is: The Bible as a sequence of events. The books that tell a story, and the chapters of the others that do; no law, no lists, no letters.

routes.name: Wisdom
routes.what_it_is: The Psalms and the Proverbs. Short lines, one thought to a verse, and the shortest way into typing whole sentences.
